newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope receives terminally ill U.S. Cardinal.
newsitem.headline: Pope receives terminally ill U.S. Cardinal.

text.p: Pope John Paul on Friday received Cardinal Joseph Bernardin, the archbishop of Chicago who is dying of cancer.
As is customary with private Papal audiences, the Vatican announced the meeting at the Papal summer residence south of Rome but did not give any details.
Bernardin, 68, announced last month that cancer had spread to his liver and that he did not have much longer to live.
Bernardin, a member of the U.S. Catholic Church's liberal wing, had extensive surgery for pancreatic cancer in 1995 followed by months of chemotherapy.
He has said the sickness has made him more aware of his own vulnerabilities and the urgent need to minister to the sick.
Bernardin is on private visit to Rome. He has told reporters he hopes to return in November to join celebrations marking the 50th anniversary of the Polish Pontiff's ordination as a priest.
